messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — after landing the batcher heuristic tweak (PR #4921) we see ~20-30% host-side CPU regression for short chat requests. P99 decode up ~120ms. Anyone else?
Ravi: Yep, reproduced locally. Flamegraph points at kernel_select() and kv_cache::evict() hot loops. My hypothesis: affinity change forces a different kernel path that increases cache churn.
Marta: I observed higher syscall counts on http2 framing too in the same runs. Small write bursts from the streamer look noisy.
Ava: Paste of simplified flame counts from a short run (symbols pruned):
```
kernel_select 35%
kv_cache::evict 22%
http2::writev 12%
grpc::frame_parser 8%
other 23%
```
Ravi: Suggestion: a lightweight kernel-affinity fast-path. Prefer "minimal-kernel" when seq_len<=64 && batch_size<=4; keep heavy kernel for larger batches. That should reduce cache layout changes and syscall pressure.
Marta: Also we can try write coalescing on the host egress path to cut small write syscalls. Kai, any quick config to test?
Kai: I tested `--http2-write-coalesce=16` on a canary and syscall tail dropped ~40%, p99 improved ~60ms. Will queue a canary with that flag.
Ravi: Another mitigation: add a KV "shadow" hint. Keep last N prefix slots pinned for minimal-kernel workloads to avoid thrash when kernels flip. Cheap to implement as a hint in kvcache metadata.
Ava: Sounds good. Plan: (1) implement kernel-affinity fast-path in runtime, (2) add KV shadow-pin hint, (3) enable http2 write coalesce in ingress for canary.
Marta: We should add a microbenchmark for the KV shadow case and include syscall counts. I'll add a perf test.
Kai: Repro command for perf infra: `./bench --profile=short-chat --seq=32 --batch=2 --concurrency=50 --capture-flame`
infra-bot: Canary deploy queued: service=ingress-hosting commit=abc123 coalesce_flag=true target=10% :rocket:
Ravi: I'll open PR for kernel-affinity + unit tests. We'll gate on perf job that runs the new microbenchmark and fails if P99 regresses >5%.
Ava: I'll own the KV hint PR and coordinate with Marta on the test.
Marta: Quick note — when you push, also enable `netstat -s` sampling for the canary so SRE can watch socket write stalls.
Kai: 👍 will monitor.
Ava: Thanks all. If canary looks good we'll roll to 100% tomorrow.
Ravi: TL;DR: kernel path flip + small-write syscall storm => kvcache thrash + p99 bump. Mitigations: kernel-affinity fast-path, kv shadow-pin, http2 write coalesce.
Marta: :+1:
file_notes: perf/host-side optimization discussion; includes flame counts and repro command
